qa.question: Does Polaris Forge 2 have its own 280 megawatt gas steam plant, or is 280 megawatts the data center load?
qa.finding: The 2025 Minnkota integrated resource plan at https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5ef212e2cdca1e094063db4e/6a32962a1710e21255119192_2025%20Integrated%20Resource%20Plan%20Public%20Website%20Final.pdf calls Polaris Forge 2 a 280 megawatt AI data center campus near Harwood and says Minnkota serves it under a data center rate. It lists no generation at the campus. The Construction Review article at https://constructionreviewonline.com/applied-digital-to-break-ground-on-3b-280mw-polaris-forge-2-ai-campus-in-north-dakota/ also describes a 280 megawatt campus powered by Minnkota and Cass County Electric Cooperative.
qa.recommendation: Treat the 280 megawatts as data center load and do not keep this unit as a generating plant unless a document shows a power plant at Harwood.
qa.note: The Minnkota plan says system upgrades and power supply resources for this load will be paid for by Applied Digital, so a future dedicated plant is possible but none is named. This is a plan source.

qa.question: Why is Minnkota Power Cooperative listed as a 50 percent owner of this unit?
qa.finding: The Minnkota plan at https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5ef212e2cdca1e094063db4e/6a32962a1710e21255119192_2025%20Integrated%20Resource%20Plan%20Public%20Website%20Final.pdf and the article at https://constructionreviewonline.com/applied-digital-to-break-ground-on-3b-280mw-polaris-forge-2-ai-campus-in-north-dakota/ show Minnkota supplying grid power to the campus. Neither says it owns generation there. The Babcock and Wilcox release at https://www.babcock.com/home/about/corporate/news/babcock-and-wilcox-receives-full-notice-to-proceed-on-24-billion-power-generation-project-for-base-electron-to-supply-power-to-applied-digital-ai-factory-campuses names no site.
qa.recommendation: Remove the 50 percent Babcock and Wilcox and 50 percent Minnkota ownership if the unit is kept. Find an owner document first.
qa.note: Same concern as at Polaris Forge 1.
